newsitem.title: USA: Tootsie Roll Industries sets extra dividend.
newsitem.headline: Tootsie Roll Industries sets extra dividend.

text.p: Tootsie Roll Industries Inc on Tuesday said its board of directors declared an extra three percent stock dividend payable April 22 to shareholders of record March 11.

The stock dividend is payable in common stock to holders of common stock and in class B shares to class B shareholders, the company said. Fractional shares will be settled by a cash payment at a rate equal to the closing price of the common stock on March 11, the company said.
Tootsie Roll Industries is a candy manufacturing company.
Its shares were up 1/8 at 42-1/8 in early afternoon.
